description: Styles for the online Tic Tac Toe game, including root variables for colors, layout styles for the app, game board, squares, buttons, and responsive design.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application container styles, centers the content vertically and horizontally.

classes.name: game-container
classes.description: Styles for the main game container with defined maximum width and centered alignment.

classes.name: game-status
classes.description: Styles for displaying the current game status with specific margin and font size.

classes.name: game-board
classes.description: Grid layout styles for the game board that defines the arrangement of squares.

classes.name: square
classes.description: Styles for each individual square on the game board, including hover effects.

classes.name: game-controls
classes.description: Container styles for game control buttons, with margin for spacing.

classes.name: button
classes.description: Styles for buttons used within the game, defining padding, colors, and hover effects.

classes.name: game-title
classes.description: Styles for the title of the game, including color, font size, and margin.
